overview.description: PT Barito Renewables Energy Tbk is an Indonesian holding company operating renewable energy assets including Star Energy Geothermal with over 880 MW operating capacity.

news.title: Barito Renewables Acquired Sidrap Wind Power Farm for Clean Energy Portfolio
news.summary: BREN completed acquisition of 75 MW Sidrap wind farm in South Sulawesi, funding via debt facilities and corporate loans.

news.title: Barito Renewables Explores Geothermal Expansion Across Salak and Wayang Windu
news.summary: BREN announced aggressive retrofit and capacity expansion plans, facing high debt amortization schedules over the next 24 months.
